title: Final velocity of P
description: Essential: The answer must state the final speed of rod P when it leaves the track as v0/2.

title: Heat generated in P
description: Essential: The answer must state the heat generated as m * v0^2.

title: Time for Q on track
description: Essential: The answer must state the time for rod Q's motion as (2mR)/(B^2 l^2).

title: Collision velocity analysis
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of momentum and energy to find post-collision velocities (P: 1.5v0, Q: 0.5v0).

title: EMF and current analysis
description: Important: The solution must apply Faraday's law and Ohm's law to relate induced EMF, current, and magnetic force on rod P.

title: Force and impulse on P
description: Important: The solution must apply the impulse-momentum theorem to rod P, linking magnetic force to its change in momentum.

title: Kinematics for Q's time
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the distance rod P travels on the track to find the time for Q's uniform motion.

title: Sign error in force/velocity
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of the magnetic force (retarding) or the sign in the impulse equation is incorrect.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers have incorrect units, missing factors (like 1/2), or misplace mass/resistance/field terms.
